title: “I want to be pushed, I want to grow”: Enabling social workers to design evaluations of LLM augmentation in their work
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a worker-driven evaluation framework and rubric for LLMs in the context of school social work. While the benchmark evaluates an LLM's ability to challenge users' assumptions and potential biases (such as cultural, racial, or economic biases), it is grounded in professional reflective practice rather than explicitly evaluating religion, theological principles, moral philosophy, or ethical frameworks.
